senses.zh: （尤指建于林中或山上的）小木屋

senses.en: having the appearance, smell, or taste of smoke
examples: Standing on the platform, we could see the [[smoky]] outline of the farther shore.

senses.en: a long line or a series of marks that have been left by sb. / sth.
examples: The wounded elephant left a [[trail]] of blood behind it.
A plane [[trailing]] a banner was circling overhead.

senses.en: pull sth. behind you, esp. along the ground, or be pulled in this way
examples: The wounded elephant left a [[trail]] of blood behind it.
A plane [[trailing]] a banner was circling overhead.

senses.en: like sugar
examples: Rhyolites (流纹岩) are rocks with a rather distinctive [[sugary]] texture or "feel."

senses.zh: （因太特别、贵重或少见而）不可替代的，独一无二的
senses.en: too special, valuable, or unusual to be replaced by anything else
examples: The works of art that were burned in the big fire are [[irreplaceable]].

senses.zh: 规则变化；节律模式；节奏
senses.en: a regular pattern of changes
examples: Long journeys can disrupt your body's natural [[rhythm]].
She started moving to the [[rhythm]] of the music.

senses.en: a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements
examples: Long journeys can disrupt your body's natural [[rhythm]].
She started moving to the [[rhythm]] of the music.

senses.en: the time when it begins to get dark in the evening
examples: Don't worry, Michael. We'll all be back by [[nightfall]].

senses.en: a period of time at night when people regularly work, esp. in a factory
examples: She is on the [[night shift]] this week, but on the day shift next week.

senses.zh: 可能存在的；可能发生的；很可能的
senses.en: likely to exist, happen, or be true
examples: The [[probable]] result of global warming will be a rise in sea levels.

senses.zh: （数量、尺寸或价格的）减少，缩小，下降
senses.en: a decrease in the amount, size, or price of sth., or the act of decreasing sth.
examples: The company promised they would make no staff [[reductions]] for at least two years.

senses.zh: 褪黑激素（有时用作安眠药）

senses.en: (medical) a mental or physical illness which prevents part of your body from working properly
examples: After weeks of tests they discovered that he had a rare [[disorder]] of the lung.

senses.en: a condition in which sb. is too fat in a way that is dangerous for their health
examples: [[Obesity]] can lead to heart disease and other health problems.

senses.en: (of birds, animals, etc.) travel regularly from one part of the world to another
examples: More than two million ducks [[migrate]] to the lake each fall.

senses.en: (AmE also turtle)

senses.zh: （毁坏庄稼或食物的）有害小动物，害虫
senses.en: a small animal or insect that destroys crops or food supplies
examples: I hope it won't be long before we can get rid of the [[pests]] altogether.

senses.en: damage or destroy sth.
examples: The building had been [[wrecked]] by the explosion.

senses.zh: （动植物的）生活环境；（动物的）栖息地
senses.en: the natural home of a plant or animal
examples: These measures will protect the [[habitat]] of endangered species such as wolves.

senses.en: prevent sth. from continuing in its usual way by causing problems
examples: Climate change and extreme weather could seriously [[disrupt]] the agricultural economy.

senses.en: all the animals and plants in a particular area, and the way in which they are related to each other and to their environment
examples: Many species of burrowing (掘洞的) insects are essential for maintaining a healthy soil [[ecosystem]].

senses.en: suddenly fail or become too weak to continue
examples: The country's auto industry nearly [[collapsed]] due to increased foreign competition.
The roof [[collapsed]] under the weight of the snow.

senses.en: fall down or fall in suddenly, often after breaking apart
examples: The country's auto industry nearly [[collapsed]] due to increased foreign competition.
The roof [[collapsed]] under the weight of the snow.

senses.en: make a light shine on sth., or fill a place with light
examples: A small path was [[illuminated]] by orange lamps concealed in the flower beds.

senses.en: private and friendly so that you feel comfortable
examples: The guests at the country club always enjoy its [[intimate]] atmosphere.
We're not on [[intimate]] terms with our neighbors.

senses.en: having an extremely close friendship
examples: The guests at the country club always enjoy its [[intimate]] atmosphere.
We're not on [[intimate]] terms with our neighbors.

senses.en: hot bright burning gas that you see when sth. is on fire
examples: They sat around the campfire, watching the flickering (摇曳的) [[flames]].

senses.en: the state of being completely alone, esp. when this is pleasant or relaxing
examples: He spent his free time in [[solitude]], reading or walking in the hills.

senses.en: extremely useful
examples: His experience of teaching in overseas schools proved [[invaluable]].

senses.en: expressing deep, usu. sad, emotions
examples: Jeanne was a romantic, mysterious young woman with [[soulful]] blue eyes and brown skin.

senses.en: having many stars
examples: We had our dinner on the grassland underneath a [[starry]] sky.

senses.en: a thick covering or area of sth.
examples: The valley was covered with a [[blanket]] of mist.
The valley was covered with a [[blanket]] of mist.

senses.en: become or make sth. become smaller or less
examples: Her enthusiasm for knitting is by now [[diminishing]] fast.

senses.en: a building, statue, or other large structure that is built to remind people of an important event or famous person
examples: These are the [[monuments]] to generations of individual farmers ploughing (犁) their fields.

senses.en: in the process of becoming sth. or being made
examples: His book was finally published. He said that it was 10 years [[in the making]].

english: simply put / to put it simply

senses.en: used for saying that you are explaining sth. in a clear and simple way
examples: Anyway, simply put, we still owe them a large amount of money.

senses.en: available only in small quantities, so that there is not enough
examples: Electricity and fresh water are [[in short supply]] on the island.
